Jobs at the Niels Bohr Institute
Go to 'Job portal - UCPH' and see if we have a vacancy that matches your dream job.
The Niels Bohr Institute builds on a strong scientific legacy shaped by more than a century of world‑leading research and teaching.
Founded by Niels Bohr with a strong commitment to international collaboration and openness, the Institute continues to foster an informal, inclusive and international research environment. We are dedicated to excellence in research, teaching and innovation, and to creating a respectful and inspiring workplace with a healthy balance between professional and private life.
We want the Niels Bohr Institute to be a place where people are proud of and happy to work, study and collaborate with.
